content.text:
He's done for! Move!
——————————————————————————
Shut it. Your life ain't worth a cat's ***.
——————————————————————————
I grabbed three thousand f**king pesos from that place.
——————————————————————————
I offed that f**k!
——————————————————————————
Crawl back to your hole. It's only cleaner than the governors' spit.
——————————————————————————
Playing tough, huh? Everyone knows your life ain't worth a single peso.
——————————————————————————
Grab the stuff and go, who gives a damn!
——————————————————————————
You a**hole!
——————————————————————————
I'd rather chew on a rusty pipe than listen to that moron and his cat-***-licking mouth for three hours.

items.text: A line of pure energy flows along the earth toward a green land deep in the valley—their destination.
A flash of light cuts through the darkness.
The world spins.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Urgh! Pull yourself together. Where are you?

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Double vision, heart palpitations, loss of perception of time and space, inability to distinguish dreams from reality. These are all common side effects.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Take three deep breaths and wait for them to pass. *panting* Take some medication distilled from agave.
The rush of teleportation gives way to the faint buzz of the microphone and the chattering din of a lively room.
Art Auction

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Here we are, the auction site, Ms. Butterfly.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Miss, are you alright? Miss?
But there's no one beside him. The mysterious intruder has already melted into the crowd.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Seems I can only wish you good luck.
Onstage, the club's owner boasts through the speakers about the items at auction, yet curiously, remains hidden from view behind a tall screen.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Distinguished Pipiltin, my ancient noble guests—

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Welcome to the Turquoise Serpent Club!

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: You, fine receivers of our invitation, are the descendants of gods and the true masters of the city! And so, tonight, we will have a feast of the arts, for arcanists only!
The invitees burst into applause. Arcanist smugglers, gangsters, and government officials alike rub elbows on the club's dance floor.

items.speaker: Smuggler I
items.text: Masters of the city, huh? I like the sound of that. This guy knows what he's doing. Must have some good stuff to sell.

items.speaker: Smuggler II
items.text: It's said that there's nothing he can't find or do within the confines of the city.

items.speaker: Smuggler II
items.text: You have any idea of the money this guy made smuggling alchemical materials? Enough to make the people living in the Palace of Iturbide jealous, I'll say that!

items.speaker: Smuggler II
items.text: Everyone here wants a slice of his pie.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: The club thanks you all for our many pleasant dealings over the years.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: In good faith for our future cooperation, I have prepared a series of arcane artworks for your perusal, all as true as gold!

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: For the fine ladies and gentlemen who are not interested in art, allow me to tell you a little secret. These paintings are only a ticket to the second half of our event.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Buy one piece, and you've won yourself a chance for deeper collaboration and even the opportunity to have a "face-to-face" chat with yours truly.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Ah, but perhaps I should not say "face." I must maintain some of my allure. Haha!
The audience laughs politely on cue.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Now, to introduce our fabulous art pieces, please welcome the rising star of Cubism, a prodigy returning from his studies in France, the greatest painter of the Turquoise Serpent Club. I give you—Muriel!
The first lot is carried onto the stage. At the same time, a boy is shoved in front of the microphone. Beneath the glaring lights, he looks pale and increasingly helpless.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Muriel, what are you doing? You're up!

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: It's called Non-Aristocratic.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: The title of this painting is Non-Aristocratic.
He turns toward the auction table timidly. He attempts to gather his thoughts, causing his words to sputter out in broken fragments.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: It's inspired by an artist I greatly admire.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: "Works that exist only on easels, and all other art loved by intellectuals, are the private property of the aristocracy."

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: Art belongs to the public. Unfortunately, I was unable to achieve this during my time in the club.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: Perhaps that's why I captured María, my tutor and friend, as she created this statue.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: Do you see this, Teresita? I know you're here.
He darts his eyes around the room, but no one seems to be paying any attention to his rambling.
The audience is swept up in the exciting news of this opportunity for cooperation.

items.speaker: Smuggler I
items.text: You heard that? This is a chance to work with him.

items.speaker: Smuggler I
items.text: If we get distributorship, we're in the big bucks.

items.speaker: Smuggler II
items.text: Damn! Now everyone wants that lousy artwork. We need to get one no matter what.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Muriel seems even rougher than the last time I saw him.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: Sorry, Mr. Pérez.

items.speaker: Muriel
items.text: I don't recall what comes next.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: You idiot! I told you to concoct an interesting story, then describe all the expensive materials you used and what arcane skills were involved!

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Get him off the stage, now! I won't have my auction ruined by some half-wit boy who's lost his mind.
The incident does little to dampen the audience's enthusiasm. The painting is soon auctioned off at a high price.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Congratulations to the fine lady who just won the bid for this great work!

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: Our next item is a very special painting. Very, very special indeed.

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: I'd love to share how I acquired such a fine piece, but I fear that might piss off a couple bigwigs, mm? So I'll keep it zipped, but let me tell you this: this next piece is more than just a painting.
The club's owner revels in the suspense before theatrically calling for the next lot.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Oh, my! Thank goodness!

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: My prayers have been heard. The soundproof fabric has finally been removed!

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: I-I'll stay quiet this time; you have my word. In fact, I'll be utterly silent unless spoken to.

items.speaker: Smuggler I
items.text: An Awakened!

items.speaker: Smuggler II
items.text: What am I looking at exactly? Is that a face?
Onstage, the painting mutters to herself.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Ah, this light is rather dazzling. I feel a little faint.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: I must say, this really isn't the right sort of place to store a painting.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Wait, am I on a stage? Why are you all looking at me?

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: What on earth is going on here?
Moments earlier, Lorentz Butterfly slipped away from Añil and into the crowd; now in short order, she finds herself backstage.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: The air here feels different.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: It's moist. This place is full of plants.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Not enough to gather the specifics of the location, but we've gone quite some way from central Mexico City.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Explains why I never found much there.
She slinks along the empty hallway.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: Auction's started. Mr. Pérez has taken the stage.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: *sigh* Wish I was sitting down there. I hear they're giving out unlimited drinks. I could use a tequila.

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: "Taken the stage," hah. He's still hiding behind that screen.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: I said what I said. Don't you think it's strange?

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: Ever since that fire last month, he hasn't shown his face.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: Hmm. You didn't hear? Mr. Pérez thinks it was an inside job.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: There's no way someone else got into the gallery that night. It could only have been one of his higher-ups.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: Still hasn't sniffed out the rat, though, so he's being extra careful for now.

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: Yeah, what do I look like, a moron? Of course I know! But what I'm saying is, he hasn't talked to anyone face-to-face. No one! Luisa, Javier, Pablo ... They can't all be traitors!

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: Leila said she heard some weird sounds coming from Mr. Pérez's room when she was on night patrol. More than once.

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: She said it sounded like some kind of scurrying thing was moving inside the walls.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: A monster in the walls?

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: I'll bet he got burned bad in that fire and doesn't want anyone to see.

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: Hey, I dare you to sneak backstage and find out.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: You crazy? I'm staying put right here. There's no bet worth risking my neck.
I could do you both the favor—find out what happened to him.
Whether taking her as an attendee or a guard they don't recognize, the two of them momentarily don't think past the helpful offer.

items.speaker: Patroller III
items.text: No kidding. Hah. You'd do that? That'd be great!

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: You should really be calling him "Mr. Pérez" here in the club though.

items.speaker: Patroller IV
items.text: Wait, who are you?

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Don't worry, my friends.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: I'll figure it all out for you.
A shame, really. The two patrollers she put down can't exactly say thank you.
She steps over her new "friends" and heads toward the club's backstage.
Backstage Corridor

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: A talking painting, you say? Don't let your eyes fool you! This is an arcanist!

items.speaker: Mr. Pérez
items.text: An Awakened from the Bateau-Lavoir, in Montmartre, Paris!

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Hm?

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: What?
There's no one behind the screen.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: What's going on here?
Yet the nonexistent "club owner" continues hawking their art as if nothing had happened.

items.speaker: "Mr. Pérez"
items.text: This is the artist's understanding of the essence of the world: a reconstruction of reality, the beauty of an unconventional brushstroke!

items.speaker: "Mr. Pérez"
items.text: And, perhaps what may interest you much more: we have discovered that within the frame of this painting, there is a vast pocket of hidden space!
Lorentz Butterfly scans the room, finding a small, unremarkable machine off to the side.
Codes, a translator, a speaker ... The learned member of the Institutum Lorentz identifies their purpose at a glance.

items.speaker: "Mr. Pérez"
items.text: A space where you might store whatever you like, so long as it isn't breathing.

items.speaker: "Mr. Pérez"
items.text: Conspicuous arcane materials, controlled items, or even your rival's severed head!

items.speaker: "Mr. Pérez"
items.text: The greatest of all secret safes, not simply behind the painting, but rather, inside the painting!

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: An audio production machine, a cupboard, and—
A faint noise emerges from the pile of notes.
Who is this woman?
And how did she get back here? For God's sake, get her out of here!

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Ha. Seems I've found the real Mr. Pérez.
